sites.provider: Vercel AI SDK generateObject / OpenAI / gpt-4o-mini
sites.downstream: result.object (genre label) printed to stdout; result.usage and result.finishReason also printed
sites.reason: Closed 5-option genre enum over trusted hardcoded input. Simple semantic classification well within Jev 1.13 strengths. No math, date comparison, multi-hop reasoning, non-text input, or large context.

options.benefit: Jev Choice is likely cheaper ($0.042/Mtok input, output free) and faster than gpt-4o-mini ($0.15/Mtok input, $0.60/Mtok output) for a 5-option genre classification. Expected cost = Jev cost + (fallback fraction × original gpt-4o-mini cost). For high-confidence inputs, nearly all decisions resolve on the Jev path.
options.risk: Serial miss adds Jev latency before original inference. Diagnostics adapter must faithfully map usage and finishReason for stdout output. Conservative posture retains gpt-4o-mini fallback permanently.

options.benefit: No change, no risk. Original behavior preserved exactly.
